note: Nomination-day report for the twenty electoral divisions of Banbridge rural district, one member each. Seventeen candidates were nominated and returned unopposed; no papers were lodged for Ballyward, Leitrim and Skeogh, whose seats were filled later by co-option. There was no contest and therefore no poll. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
